crossRefs.note: Let still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy…
Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason…
Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.
Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?
If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden…
“Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?
If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.
Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right:
Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
“Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

translations.web: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’
translations.bsb: You have said, ‘My doctrine is sound, and I am pure in Your sight.’
translations.kjv: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.
translations.asv: For thou sayest, My doctrine is pure, And I am clean in thine eyes.
